digest.component_or_area: MCP and review-bot startup configuration and authentication binding
propositions: MCP and review-bot mix startup deployment policy with per-operation config and ambient auth reads, causing static material to change or be reread inconsistently during long-running operations.

Startup/static bindings must be composed once at service startup and never re-read from environment/file; each operation receives a fresh non-secret OperationSnapshot; inbound tokens remain request-scoped and never enter startup snapshots or logs.

Review-bot must validate decision-bearing auth (Gerrit/GitHub credentials) before accepting work, construct only the selected provider integration, and reject with no fallback on missing or conflicting credentials.
MCP gate currently re-reads load_config() per call instead of per-operation; review-bot validates Gerrit auth lazily inside /rerun and does not forward LLMRuntime to adapters.
Static binding changes are observed only after process restart; native refreshable capability behavior remains SDK-owned and unchanged.
Partial or rejected Langfuse/OTLP telemetry setup must disable telemetry without changing the operation result; security-bearing auth remains fail-closed and never falls back.
